title: AR2 Script most advanced script best features
features:
========================================

COMBAT



[Silent Aim]

  • Silent Aim Toggle

  • Visibility Check

  • Team Check

  • Snap Line (Visual line to target)

  • Hit Chance (1-100%)

  • Max Distance (100-2000 studs)

  • Target Part Selection (Head, UpperTorso, LowerTorso, HumanoidRootPart, Arms, Legs)

  • Show FOV Circle

  • FOV Radius (0-1000)

  • Randomize Body Part

  • Head/Torso/Limbs Chance Sliders (%)



[Aimbot]

  • Aimbot Toggle

  • Max Distance (100-1000 studs)

  • Target Part Selection

  • Keybind

  • Show FOV Circle

  • FOV Radius (0-800)

  • Snap Line

  • Smoothing (1-30)

  • Prediction (0-20)



[Gun Mods]

  • No Recoil

  • Bullet Prediction

  • No Spread

  • Magic Bullet



========================================

VISUALS



[Player ESP]

  • ESP Toggle

  • Name ESP

  • Box ESP (Corner / 2D)

  • Distance ESP

  • Equipped Item ESP

  • Chams

  • Chams Transparency (1-10)

  • Max Distance (100-10000 studs)



[Vehicle ESP]

  • Vehicle ESP Toggle

  • Vehicle Name

  • Vehicle Distance



[Corpse ESP]

  • Corpse ESP Toggle

  • Corpse Name

  • Corpse Distance



[Zombie ESP]

  • Zombie ESP Toggle

  • Zombie Name

  • Zombie Distance

  • Zombie Chams

  • Zombie Chams Transparency

  • Zombie Max Distance (50-3000 studs)



[Random Event ESP]

  • Event ESP Toggle

  • Show Name

  • Show Distance

  • Spawn Notifications

  • Event Filter (Enable/Disable specific events)



[World Visuals]

  • Fullbright

  • No Fog

  • No Shadows



========================================

MISCELLANEOUS



[General]

  • Instant Search (Skip search animation)

  • Instant Reload

  • Inventory Move (Move while in inventory)

  • Anti Zombie (Freeze nearby zombies)

  • No Swim Restriction (Equip items while swimming)

  • Fly + Keybind

  • Lag Switch + Keybind (Velocity Desync with ghost visualization)



[Loot Utils]

  • Keep Containers Open (Persistent container access)

  • Open Containers Key (Mass open containers keybind)



========================================

VEHICLES



[Speed]

  • Throttle Power (1-50x)

  • Max Speed Multiplier (1-30x)

  • Acceleration (1-20x)



[Handling]

  • Steer Power (1-30x)

  • Steer Speed (1-20x)

  • Brake Power (1-20x)



[Physics]

  • Tire Grip (1-20x)

  • Suspension Height (1-30x)



[Extras]

  • Infinite Nitro

  • Infinite Fuel

  • No Vehicle Damage

  • Revert All to Default (Button)



========================================

SETTINGS



[UI Keybinds]

  • Menu Toggle Key (Default: F5)



[Config System]

  • Create Config

  • Config List Dropdown

  • Load Config

  • Overwrite Config

  • Delete Config

  • Refresh List

  • Set as Autoload

  • Reset Autoload
